Reception Admissions - September 2027
If your child is born between 01/09/2022 and 31/08/2023, they are due to start Reception in September 2026 and you will need to apply for a primary school place.
The deadline for applications is 15th January 2027.
We are holding Reception open mornings and evenings on the dates and times below:
Please book your place via our online booking form which can be found by visiting:
https://forms.gle/AWWi89d31ED65G1D9
Please see below the planned admission timetable and link to the Royal Borough of Greenwich primary school admission guide.
Application period opens
Application period closes
Application results are published
Acceptance period closes
Appeals period closes
